changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql: delete from graph.AssetEdge where $edge_id in ( select E.$edge_id from graph.AssetNode S, graph.AssetEdge E, graph.AssetNode T where MATCH(S-(E)->T) and E.PredicateType in (3,4) and not exists (select 1 from [IntersectDetail] where IntersectTypeID = E.IntersectTypeID and SubjectUid = S.[Uid] and ObjectUId = T.[Uid]) )
